summary: Open Text Corporation filed a Form 8-K on August 6, 2026, reporting its quarterly financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, and announcing a quarterly cash dividend of $0.28 per common share, payable on September 18, 2026, to shareholders of record on September 4, 2026. The dividend is a routine capital return under the company's dividend policy. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review is indicated. The filing is a standard earnings and dividend announcement, so no special situation classification applies.
